parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH=12 (1.0614 vs 1.0401). The capacity jump is causing instability within the 5-minute budget. Reverting to my best DEPTH=8/AR64 config. Next: I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 to see if a hotter LR helps D8/AR64, matching the trend of higher LRs helping depth.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.12 on DEPTH=8/ASPECT_RATIO=64 to seek better convergence.
